impact_assessment.why: Integrate AIKit governance, disruption recovery, hygiene, test harness, and living memory into CardMon
impact_assessment.benefits: Brings CardMon under AIKit cockpit management, automated verification gates, test regression shield, and license compliance
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing web UI logic must remain intact; dependency: no external runtime dependencies should be introduced; concurrency: none; state: localStorage schema and offline capabilities must be preserved
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use Node.js standard library test runner (node --test) without npm dependencies; keep existing scripts intact; add hygiene annotations for necessary third-party assets

description: [3/4] Zero-dependency Node.js test harness and test suite
